sources.title: siglip-so400m-patch14-384 · Models
sources.snippet: SigLIP (shape-optimized model) SigLIP model pre-trained on WebLi at resolution 384x384. It was introduced in the paper Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training by Zhai et al. and first released in this repository. This model has the SoViT-400m architecture, which is the shape-optimized version as presented in Getting ViT in Shape: Scaling Laws for Compute-Optimal Model Design by ...
